STS2ARIS-CHARGE.title: Charge
STS2ARIS-CHARGE.description: You may spend [gold]Charge[/gold] in place of missing Energy to play cards. Charge is lost at the end of the turn.
STS2ARIS-SHOCK.title: Shock
STS2ARIS-SHOCK.description: Whenever this creature is attacked, it loses HP equal to its [gold]Shock[/gold], then its Shock is reduced by 1.
STS2ARIS-OVERLOAD.title: Overload
STS2ARIS-OVERLOAD.description: Triggers if you have 0 Energy after playing this card.
STS2ARIS-OUTPUT.title: Output
STS2ARIS-OUTPUT.description: You cannot spend [gold]Charge[/gold] to play this card.
STS2ARIS-EQUIPMENT.title: Equipment
STS2ARIS-EQUIPMENT.description: When played, this is equipped and changes your [gold]Job[/gold]. If you already have [gold]Equipment[/gold], the old Equipment is discarded.
STS2ARIS-CLASSCHANGE.title: Class Change
STS2ARIS-CLASSCHANGE.description: An effect that triggers when your [gold]Job[/gold] changes.
STS2ARIS-JOB.title: Job
STS2ARIS-JOB.description: A [gold]Job[/gold] effect applies while its [gold]Equipment[/gold] is equipped. You can have only 1 Job at a time.
STS2ARIS-REWARD.title: Reward
STS2ARIS-REWARD.description: A card that cannot be obtained normally and is earned by completing a [gold]Quest[/gold].
STS2ARIS-QUEST.title: Quest
STS2ARIS-QUEST.description: Transforms into its [gold]Reward[/gold] card when its condition is fulfilled.
